body: I guess `PanelWidgetOptions` should be renamed to `PanelWidgetParams`?
In other stories we call these `numericMenuContainer`.
You can remove `createURL` when they're empty. They're covered by `createRenderOptions`.

I am not sure, because for types is always have been WidgetOptions.

Anyways, going to address of all of that together.

Just created this task for that: https://algolia.atlassian.net/browse/IFW-1260
Any reasons the `createRenderOptions` and `createInitOptions` are not used below?
Fixed. Note that the snapshots got updated as we use a templateConfig as object instead of undefined.
We can type the template [as described in the documentation](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/numeric-menu/js/#widget-param-item) since it's generic.
